General.Description:
Blacksmith's apprentice Sable Vorn never wanted a throne. But when the long-dead Ember Throne of Keldrath ignites for the first time in three centuries and names her its chosen ruler, she has little choice. The fire will spread — consuming everything — unless she claims what she never asked for.

Director Sofia Brennan brings Caelindra Foss's beloved debut novel to the screen with stunning visual ambition, transforming the crumbling republic of Keldrath into a fully realised world of warring factions, ancient pyromantic magic, and political intrigue. Zara Okonkwo delivers a career-defining performance as Sable — fierce, funny, and deeply reluctant — while Damian Stroud brings unexpected depth to the calculating High Chancellor who has waited thirty years for this moment.

Shot on location in Iceland and New Zealand with extensive practical fire effects, The Ember Throne is an epic fantasy that earns its scale through the intimacy of its central character. A triumphant adaptation.
